snippet.title: BEANDEJO // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207200/BEANDEJO/

BEANDEJO is an action-packed spin-gun roguelite. Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons. Spin your gun, time your draws, and gun them down to become the toughest sheriff in town!

Developed by 
Sparrow Bomb aka @SparrowBombGames
